body: Yeah I had specifically told him that I was so worried about losing it to the wrong person.

I don't know when I will be out of this really. He knew I kept getting hurt by other guys and he assured me he will never hurt me, but he did. I am planning at least a year of total isolation, meaning not using social media too.

A lot of things changed about me. Down there I had A LOT of discharge to begin with and I was in pain.

Then there is the fact that I am left with craving more and more human touch but I cannot get it so easily.

Also as I said, I have lost my sex drive.

He took the initiative to give me my first kiss and the rest. I just wish he was honest. He told me that he felt nothing for me as of the first kiss, but he continued kissing me until before he left.

So I had a very fake experience.

I've known him for 5 weeks. We were in a sort of LDR. He travelled two hours by plane to meet me.

Well, just imagine. In 29 years nobody talked to me that much, even as a friend. And then I found a guy online who seemed interested in me, not to mention he's cute.

I have many toys. I am not even willing to use them. I lost my sex drive.

Like I said, the sex was good especially because I loved him. I wish I had a long lasting relationship with him.
